input_example.question: What is the distribution of synthetic readings?

data.question: What is the distribution of synthetic readings?
data.reproducible_script:
PAYLOAD_JSON = '{"rows": [{"reading": 1}, {"reading": 3}, {"reading": null}], "columns": ["reading"]}'
import json, math, statistics
payload = json.loads(PAYLOAD_JSON)
rows = payload["rows"]
stats = {}
for column in payload["columns"]:
    raw = [row.get(column) for row in rows]
    values = [v for v in raw if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and math.isfinite(v)]
    missing = sum(v is None for v in raw)
    stats[column] = {"n": len(values), "missing": missing, "invalid": len(raw)-missing-len(values),
                     "missing_fraction": missing/len(rows) if rows else None,
                     "mean": statistics.mean(values) if values else None,
                     "median": statistics.median(values) if values else None,
                     "sample_sd": statistics.stdev(values) if len(values)>1 else None,
                     "min": min(values) if values else None, "max": max(values) if values else None}
print(json.dumps(stats, sort_keys=True))
data.analysis_method: Available finite numeric values per column; sample standard deviation uses n-1; no imputation
